title: git vouch did: key line with a long base64 run crashes
description: _key_did tried Path(arg).is_file() first; a key line's base64 contains '/', and a run of more than 255 characters between two of them makes stat fail with ENAMETOOLONG, so about 1 in 40-60 real ssh-keygen RSA keys made git vouch did crash with a traceback (and test_real_key_round_trips_through_ssh_keygen[rsa] flaky). Found 2026-10-23 in the xlha.21 gate.
close_reason: OSError from is_file means not a file; test_key_line_too_long_for_a_path_is_read_as_a_key pins the ssh-keygen key; 100/100 fresh RSA keys round-trip
